start.title: New run

rules.title: Rules
rules.first: Only the first Pokémon you meet in each area can be caught.
rules.faint: A Pokémon that faints is dead and can't be used again.
rules.dupesText: If the first Pokémon in an area is from a family you've already caught, you can pass on it and catch the next one.
rules.shinyText: A shiny can always be caught, and it doesn't use up the area's encounter.
rules.gifts: Gift Pokémon count as the area's encounter
rules.giftsText: A gift, in-game trade, egg or fossil uses up its area's encounter; when this is off, it's a free extra.
rules.staticsText: A Pokémon you walk up to, or a roaming one, uses up its area's encounter; when this is off, it's a free extra.
rules.capsText: Shows the level of the next boss's strongest Pokémon, so you know not to train past it.
rules.storyCaps: Rival and villain battles set the level cap
rules.storyCapsText: Usually the cap is the next gym leader's (or totem's, or kahuna's). With this on, the next rival or villain battle counts too. Battles you can skip never do.

header.badgeAdd: Badges: {n} of {total}. Tap to add one, hold to take one off.

header.deleteText: {name} and everything logged in it will be gone from this device. Export a backup first if you might want it back.
